raw_text: کوٹلی سیکٹر میں ایس ایس جی کی تربیتی سرگرمیاں۔ Reports from ground contacts in Kotli sector indicate heightened Pakistan SSG movement near the training facility. Unusual number of military vehicles spotted on roads leading to the camp. Local sources say exercises have been ongoing for four days. Indian side reportedly monitoring via drones.
clean_text: Pakistan SSG heightened activity at Kotli training facility. Military vehicles on camp roads. Exercises ongoing four days. Indian drone monitoring reported.
